description: This file contains functions for resolving conversation binding contexts, channels, account IDs, and thread IDs based on message context and command parameters in a chat application.

methods.name: resolveBindingChannel
methods.description: Resolves the conversation channel from context and optional command channel, normalizing the text.

methods.name: resolveBindingAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID based on context, plugin registry, and configuration, defaulting to 'default' if none found.

methods.name: resolveBindingThreadId
methods.description: Normalizes and resolves the thread ID from various possible input types.

methods.name: resolveConversationBindingContextFromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a conversation binding context from message parameters and context.

methods.name: resolveConversationBindingContextFromAcpCommand
methods.description: Constructs a conversation binding context from command parameters.

methods.name: resolveConversationBindingChannelFromMessage
methods.description: Resolves the conversation channel from message context and optional command channel.

methods.name: resolveConversationBindingAccountIdFromMessage
methods.description: Resolves the account ID from message context and parameters.

methods.name: resolveConversationBindingThreadIdFromMessage
methods.description: Resolves the thread ID from message context.
